prompt: Explain to me how a gain and lift chart is calculated and how it should be interpreted
response: A gain and lift chart is a graphical representation used in predictive modeling to evaluate the performance of a model. It shows the gain and lift measures at different thresholds. The gain chart measures the incremental benefit of including additional records in the analysis, while the lift chart measures the probability of selecting a record from the top of the ranked list. Both are used to assess the effectiveness of the model in identifying high-risk or high-value cases.
